k: Robe headgear. Immune to Silence. The Rime Sovereign wore it for a kingdom of no one.
src: 'Robe headgear. Immune to Silence. The Rime Sovereign wore it for a kingdom of no one.'

k: Unsent. "To my squire, whoever he turns out to be."
src: 'Unsent. "To my squire, whoever he turns out to be."'

k: STR +18, critical rate +12%. The Lodge's founder, avenged.
src: 'STR +18, critical rate +12%. The Lodge\'s founder, avenged.'

k: Start battles with Veil (dodge two attacks). It rings very quietly.
src: 'Start battles with Veil (dodge two attacks). It rings very quietly.'

k: Moor dogs gone wild. Polite, until they are not.
src: 'Moor dogs gone wild. Polite, until they are not.'

k: Follow it, and you will find exactly what it wants you to find.
src: 'Follow it, and you will find exactly what it wants you to find.'

k: Barnacled to the causeway for so long it forgot how to leave.
src: 'Barnacled to the causeway for so long it forgot how to leave.'

k: It focuses sunlight into anyone foolish enough to look at it.
src: 'It focuses sunlight into anyone foolish enough to look at it.'

k: Lives in the flooded galleries. Eats astronomers, historically.
src: 'Lives in the flooded galleries. Eats astronomers, historically.'

k: Built by the first Keepers to measure the sun. Still measuring.
src: 'Built by the first Keepers to measure the sun. Still measuring.'

k: Still at their posts. Nobody relieved them.
src: 'Still at their posts. Nobody relieved them.'

k: A soldier who broke an oath here. It is still sorry.
src: 'A soldier who broke an oath here. It is still sorry.'

k: Mange's pack. They guard the graves.
Empty armor that remembers the drill.
Gulls that flew too close to the broken sun.
src: 'Gulls that flew too close to the broken sun.'

k: Coal-bellied dogs of the ash wastes.
Grows a shell from fallen window-glass.
Ash that remembers being a person.
They hang right-way-up now, which is to say, upside-down.
src: 'They hang right-way-up now, which is to say, upside-down.'

k: Still singing the wedding hymn. Still a little flat.
src: 'Still singing the wedding hymn. Still a little flat.'

k: A bell-clapper that grew arms. It strikes on the hour.
src: 'A bell-clapper that grew arms. It strikes on the hour.'

k: A note that refused to end.
A white flower that bites the hand that waters it.
src: 'A white flower that bites the hand that waters it.'

k: It eats the last words before they can be said.
src: 'It eats the last words before they can be said.'

k: Someone who did not get to say goodbye.
src: 'Someone who did not get to say goodbye.'

k: Planted over a grave a century ago. It grieves slowly.
src: 'Planted over a grave a century ago. It grieves slowly.'

k: Bounty. Ate a cart. The cart was occupied.
src: 'Bounty. Ate a cart. The cart was occupied.'

k: Bounty. Its lure is the last light many travelers saw.
src: 'Bounty. Its lure is the last light many travelers saw.'

k: Bounty. A cairn that got hungry.
Bounty. Flew through the broken sun.
Bounty. It speaks with the voices of the buried.
src: 'Bounty. It speaks with the voices of the buried.'

k: Bounty. Do not let her hold your hand.
src: 'Bounty. Do not let her hold your hand.'

k: Built by the first Keepers to guard what they chose never to do.
src: 'Built by the first Keepers to guard what they chose never to do.'

k: The fort commander's ceremonial armor. Someone has to hold the stair.
src: 'The fort commander\'s ceremonial armor. Someone has to hold the stair.'

k: A bell that would not stop ringing, because stopping meant goodbye.
src: 'A bell that would not stop ringing, because stopping meant goodbye.'

k: It wanted to keep every last word. It kept too many.
src: 'It wanted to keep every last word. It kept too many.'

k: Hidden hunt. It killed the Lodge's founder, and it remembers how he tasted.
src: 'Hidden hunt. It killed the Lodge\'s founder, and it remembers how he tasted.'

k: Hidden hunt. It does not shine. It takes.
src: 'Hidden hunt. It does not shine. It takes.'

k: Bristleback paws the ground, head low...
The lure brightens. Something huge opens beneath it...
src: 'The lure brightens. Something huge opens beneath it...'

k: Gravelgut swallows a cairn and hardens!
The Pinch opens its great claw wide...
src: 'The Pinch opens its great claw wide...'

k: Cinderwing climbs into the ash, burning brighter...
src: 'Cinderwing climbs into the ash, burning brighter...'

k: Gravemouth inhales. A hundred buried voices fall silent...
src: 'Gravemouth inhales. A hundred buried voices fall silent...'

k: The Choirmother raises her baton for the final verse...
src: 'The Choirmother raises her baton for the final verse...'

k: She holds out her hand. Do not take it...
src: 'She holds out her hand. Do not take it...'

k: Light gathers at the orrery's center...
The Iron Duke takes a two-handed stance.
src: 'The Iron Duke takes a two-handed stance.'

k: The Duke raises his greatsword high...
The bell tolls, and a note takes shape!
src: 'The bell tolls, and a note takes shape!'

k: The great bell swings back, back, back...
src: 'The great bell swings back, back, back...'

k: The Last Bloom drinks the whole garden's voice!
src: 'The Last Bloom drinks the whole garden\'s voice!'

k: A thousand petal-mouths open at once...
The Bane of Harrow roars. Its wounds close!
src: 'The Bane of Harrow roars. Its wounds close!'

k: It drags itself up for one last killing lunge...
src: 'It drags itself up for one last killing lunge...'

k: The Bane lowers its head. Its jaws unhinge...
src: 'The Bane lowers its head. Its jaws unhinge...'

k: The Black Star swallows the light. Time slows.
src: 'The Black Star swallows the light. Time slows.'

k: The Black Star collapses inward — everything is pulled toward it!
src: 'The Black Star collapses inward — everything is pulled toward it!'

k: Every light in the sky bends toward the Black Star...
src: 'Every light in the sky bends toward the Black Star...'
